title: FZ-X Chrome Retro (Adventure Spec)
description: The Yamaha FZ-X Chrome Retro (Adventure Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
